notes.title: Voiceover and scaling
notes.content:
Wordlase just received a major update - all the story texts have voiceovers! Great thanks to Tiana Lisp for doing the voice acting for most of the languages.

Scaling had a significant change. Now the game has much fewer graphical artifacts on big screens. It changed how the game initializes, so the game should start much faster and smoother. Enjoy!

notes.title: Simple Video Merger released
notes.content:
Simple Video Merger joins multiple videos together. Take some videos recorded on the same device and merge them into the single one. No setup, no options, no animation, just one video after another with a few mouse clicks! Few minutes of processing for a multiple hours of video. Fast and Simple.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293350/Simple_Video_Merger/
